lines.en: label day302:
scene toukatsubasameeting1
Several days have passed since Touka transferred into class and, it might come as a shock to hear this, but they haven’t gone very well.
lines.zh: Touka 转进班上已经过去好几天了，说出来也许令人震惊，但进展并不太顺利。

lines.en: I figured that if I was able to get Makoto to give up on her education, I’d certainly be able to get someone like Touka to do it as well.
lines.zh: 我本以为，如果我能让 Makoto 放弃她的学业，那就一定也能让 Touka 这样的人照做。

lines.en: Granted, Makoto hasn’t really given up on her education and has instead just forced herself into perpetual solo study mode-
lines.zh: 话说回来，Makoto 其实并没有真的放弃学业，只是把自己逼进了永久的自习模式——

lines.en: But still, I figured a taste of freedom would probably be good for someone like Touka, who’s never really experienced that before.
lines.zh: 但尽管如此，我觉得让 Touka 这种从未体验过自由的人尝一口自由的滋味，大概对她有好处。

lines.en: And yet here I am, leaning back in my office chair and waiting for a knock on my door to signal what I imagine is going to be a rather annoying meeting with her and her mother.
lines.zh: 然而此刻，我正靠在办公椅上，等着敲门声响起，宣告那场我想象中和她们母女进行的、相当烦人的会面。

lines.en: Any second now, the princess will bust through these doors with a pout on her face and demand that I be relieved of my duties or something along those lines.
lines.zh: 随时，公主殿下就会噘着嘴冲进门来，要求解除我的职务，或者类似的话。

lines.en: I mean, in her defense, she’s probably right. But no one else is complaining, so I am clearly at an advantage here.
lines.zh: 我得说句公道话，她大概是对的。但别人都没在抱怨，所以我显然占着优势。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: Hopefully.
lines.zh: 但愿如此。

lines.en: Well, at least it’s been fun.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少这段时间挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Come in.
lines.zh: : 请进。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting2
: Hmph!
: Sincerest apologies for keeping you so late.
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉让您留到这么晚。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I didn’t really have anything else to do anyway.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我也没什么别的事要做。

lines.en: : But, just out of curiosity, is she going to stand there and pout for the entire meeting?
lines.zh: : 不过，只是好奇问一下，她打算在整个会议期间都站在那儿噘嘴吗？

lines.en: : I’d like to know in advance if I can get away with saying anything I want.
lines.zh: : 我想提前知道，自己是不是可以想说什么就说什么。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting3
: Of course not!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！

lines.en: : I will be participating in the meeting! It was my decision to hold it, after all!
lines.zh: : 我会参与这场会议！毕竟是我决定要开这场会的！

lines.en: : Which, surprisingly enough, you actually showed up for.
lines.zh: : 而且，令人惊讶的是，你还真来了。

lines.en: : I certainly did.
lines.zh: : 我当然来了。

lines.en: : Though, mostly out of curiosity as to why exactly you called for it and why your mother needs to be involved.
lines.zh: : 不过主要是好奇，你到底为什么召开这场会，以及为什么你母亲非得在场。

lines.en: : Please forgive her. Touka doesn’t typically take it upon herself to resolve her own issues, so this is actually a step in the right direction.
lines.zh: : 请原谅她。Touka 平时不会主动去解决自己的问题，所以这其实是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。

lines.en: : Granted, she hasn’t exactly...run into many issues. So this is entirely new for all of us.
lines.zh: : 虽说她其实也没……遇到多少问题。所以这对我们所有人来说都是全新的体验。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting4
: I have been here for almost a full week now...and I feel no different than I did when I first arrived.
lines.zh: : 我来这里已经快整整一周了……却感觉和刚来的时候没有任何不同。

lines.en: : Well, what exactly did you think was going to happen in just one week?
lines.zh: : 那么，你到底以为仅仅一周之内会发生什么？

lines.en: : Something? Anything?
lines.zh: : 某件事？任何事？

lines.en: : Every day has been a complete free for all without any direction or schedule and, yes, it is possible that I may just be too “sheltered” to know how commoners study-
lines.zh: : 每一天都是彻底的无序状态，没有任何方向或日程，是的，也许我只是被“保护”得太好，不知道平民是怎么学习的——

lines.en: : Touka.
lines.zh: : Touka。

lines.en: : Apologies. How the lower middle class studies.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。不知道下层中产阶级是怎么学习的。

lines.en: I actually think I prefer commoner to that.
lines.zh: 我倒是觉得，“平民”比这个说法好多了。

lines.en: : But I just have a hard time understanding why your methods are the way they are...and how exactly I’m supposed to make use of my time.
lines.zh: : 但我就是很难理解，你的方法为什么是这个样子……以及我到底该怎么利用自己的时间。

lines.en: : Just talk to the other girls and have fun. Or ask the girl with the glasses to help you.
lines.zh: : 跟其他女孩聊聊天、找点乐子就行。或者找那个戴眼镜的女孩帮你。

lines.en: : But there are three girls who wear glasses in our classroom and one of them seems significantly less smart than the others.
lines.zh: : 但我们班上有三个戴眼镜的女孩，其中一个看起来明显比另外两个笨。

lines.en: : Then just...choose the one that looks like a student council president. The other two are weird.
lines.zh: : 那就……挑那个看起来像学生会主席的。另外两个很怪。

lines.en: : And sorry. I’m still getting used to the sudden increase in glasses.
lines.zh: : 还有抱歉。我还在适应眼镜数量突然变多这件事。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting5
: Why can’t you just teach me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不能直接教我？

lines.en: : I had my secretary run a background check on you and confirmed that you have an extensive history in literature, and yet you haven't even attempted to showcase that.
lines.zh: : 我让我的秘书对你做了背景调查，确认你在文学方面有着深厚的履历，可你甚至都没有尝试展示过这一点。

lines.en: : I’m so confused.
lines.zh: : 我很困惑。

lines.en: : First, why do you have a secretary? You’re a [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 首先，你为什么会有秘书？你只是个 [teenage]女孩。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting6
: At what age do most commoner girls get their secretaries?
lines.zh: : 平民家的女孩大多是什么年纪才有秘书的？

lines.en: : To be quite honest, I thought we were starting Touka rather late. Tsukasa already has one as well.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还觉得我们给 Touka 配得算晚的呢。Tsukasa 也已经有一个了。

lines.en: : Well it makes sense for Tsukasa because she is a 5,000 year old wizard.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Tsukasa 有秘书是说得通的，因为她是个五千岁的巫师。

lines.en: : If I didn’t have a secretary, who would answer the phone for me?
lines.zh: : 如果我没有秘书，谁来替我接电话？

lines.en: : Just answer it yourself.
lines.zh: : 自己接啊。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting7
: Can I do that?
lines.zh: : 我可以那样做吗？

lines.en: : I don’t see why not. I’ve been answering mine for quite some time now.
lines.zh: : 我看不出有什么不可以。我自己接自己的电话已经有好一阵子了。

lines.en: : Great. So now that we’ve fired your secretary, let me ask why you took it upon yourself to run a background check on me.
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，既然我们已经把你的秘书解雇了，我想问问你为什么自作主张对我做背景调查。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting8
: Because you make me mad! And I wanted to confirm that you are not just a man posing as a teacher!
lines.zh: : 因为你让我生气！我想确认你不是一个只是装成老师的人！

lines.en: : You know, up until recently, I probably would have shrugged and looked away in response to that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，放在不久以前，我大概会对此耸耸肩、把头转开。

lines.en: : But now, I can safely tell you that I am maybe probably almost certain that I’m a real teacher, kind of.
lines.zh: : 但现在，我可以放心地告诉你，我大概、也许、几乎可以确定我是个真正的老师，算是吧。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting9
: Can we really not find anyone else to take care of me? I can’t even follow a casual conversation with this man.
lines.zh: : 我们真的找不到别的人来教我吗？我甚至连和这个男人的日常对话都跟不上。

lines.en: : You just have to stop placing yourself so highly above him, dear.
lines.zh: : 你只要别再把自己摆得比他高那么多就行了，亲爱的。

lines.en: : He would not have been hired here if it weren’t for his ability. And he’s responsible for two of the smartest girls in the entire city.
lines.zh: : 如果不是有本事，他是不会被这里录用的。而且全城最聪明的两个女孩，都是由他负责的。

lines.en: : I understand that. But it could very well be that those two are just naturally gifted and he conveniently wound up with them in his classroom.
lines.zh: : 这我明白。但也完全有可能是那两个女孩天资聪颖，而他只是碰巧把她们收进了自己的班上。

lines.en: Bingo.
lines.zh: 答对了。

lines.en: : Or...perhaps it’s just time to do things a little differently?
lines.zh: : 或者……也许是时候换个方式做事了？

lines.en: : Differently how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不同法？

lines.en: : Well...if you’re going to be taking over the family business, don’t you think it would be good for you to at least understand the mindset of the common man?
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果你将来要接手家族事业，你不觉得至少了解一下平民的思维方式，对你有好处吗？

lines.en: : Or, at the very least...express yourself like the common people, but think like a wise man.
lines.zh: : 或者，最起码……像平民一样表达自己，像智者一样思考。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting10
: Excuse me, Sensei. But if you’re so smart, how about you tell us who my mother was quoting just-
lines.zh: : 打扰一下，Sensei。既然你这么聪明，那不如你告诉我们，我母亲刚刚引用的是谁——

lines.en: : Aristotle.
lines.zh: : 亚里士多德。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting11
: Wha-
: How did you know that?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道的？！

lines.en: How did I know that?
lines.zh: 我是怎么知道的？

lines.en: : See, dear? He clearly knows what he’s doing. His methods are just a little unusual.
lines.zh: : 看见了吗，亲爱的？他显然知道自己在做什么。只是他的方法有点不寻常。

lines.en: : That’s even worse because it means he is intentionally toying with me rather than subconsciously doing it like everyone else does!
lines.zh: : 那就更糟了，因为这意味着他是故意在耍我，而不是像其他人那样无意识地这么做！

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting12
: This man is a bully! I demand he be removed from the premises at once!
lines.zh: : 这个男人是个恶霸！我要求立刻把他赶出校园！

lines.en: : No one is removing anyone, dear...
lines.zh: : 没人要赶走谁，亲爱的……

lines.en: : You’re going to be the good girl I know you are and do everything this man tells you to do from now on.
lines.zh: : 你要做我认识的那个乖女孩，从今往后，这个男人让你做什么，你就做什么。

lines.en: Those are extremely dangerous words and I can not wait to exploit them.
lines.zh: 这话可太危险了，我迫不及待要好好利用一番。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting13
: But...Mother! He makes me feel insignificant and weak! I’m the heiress of the Tsukioka family. I can’t afford to be-
lines.zh: : 可是……母亲！他让我觉得自己渺小又软弱！我是 Tsukioka 家的继承人。我不能——

lines.en: : Laaaaame.
scene toukatsubasameeting14
: You’re not insignificant and you’re not weak. I know it and you know it. But you have to prove that in the outside world.
lines.zh: : 你不渺小，也不软弱。我知道，你也知道。但你必须在外面的世界去证明这一点。

lines.en: : She’s right.
lines.zh: : 她说的对。

lines.en: : Like I was saying the day you transferred in, you’re no better than any of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 就像你转进来那天我说的那样，你并不比其他任何一个女孩强到哪里去。

lines.en: : You’re not going to get any special treatment in my class. But you are going to get the opportunity to be a normal girl for once.
lines.zh: : 在我的班上，你不会得到任何特殊待遇。但你会得到一次机会，去做一回普通的女孩。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting15
: I believed you the first time you said that, but I’m already beginning to have my doubts after hearing it several more times.
lines.zh: : 你第一次说这话的时候我是信的，但后来又听了几遍，我已经开始怀疑了。

lines.en: : I don’t feel normal at all. The classroom is...loud.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不觉得自己正常。教室里……很吵。

lines.en: : And I also think one of the girls carries a weapon.
lines.zh: : 而且我还觉得，其中一个女孩随身带着武器。

lines.en: : A few of them do, but that’s not important.
lines.zh: : 有几个确实带着，但那不重要。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting16
: Is the lower middle class truly that horrifying?
lines.zh: : 下层中产阶级真的有那么可怕吗？

lines.en: : It can be. But it can also be kind of freeing if you can look past the slow creep of debt and all of the other depressing stuff we'll have to deal with in our lifetimes.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但如果你能越过债务缓慢攀升、以及我们这辈子不得不面对的其他那些令人沮丧的东西，它也可以算是一种自由。

lines.en: : Thankfully, that’s not something that will ever befall you. So you’re free to just have fun.
lines.zh: : 幸好，那些永远不会落到你头上。所以你只管尽情玩就好。

lines.en: : But...how do I do that?
lines.zh: : 可是……我该怎么做呢？

lines.en: : Well, I mentioned it to Tsubasa when we first talked about you transferring in, but why not try moving into the dorms?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我和 Tsubasa 第一次谈你转学的时候就提过，为什么不试试搬进宿舍呢？

lines.en: : There's only one room open right now, but-
lines.zh: : 现在只剩一个空房间，不过——

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting17
: Apologies. The what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你说什么？

lines.en: : They’re like little apartments for girls attending[school] together. I learned about them the other day.
lines.zh: : 就像是给一起上[school]的女孩们住的小公寓。我前几天才知道的。

lines.en: : They sound quite delightful, actually. But I understand if you wouldn’t want to live there just yet.
lines.zh: : 其实听起来相当不错。不过我理解，你现在还不想住在那儿。

lines.en: : These...dorms...
lines.zh: : 这些……宿舍……

lines.en: : Do...all of the girls in our class live together under one roof?
lines.zh: : 我们班的所有女孩……都住在同一屋檐下吗？

lines.en: : Yup. They certainly do.
lines.zh: : 对。她们确实如此。

lines.en: This is normally the part where I’d tell her that I basically live there as well, but I’m probably better off concealing that until I can get Touka to like me a little bit more.
lines.zh: 通常到这儿，我就会告诉她我基本也住在那儿，但大概还是先瞒着比较好，等我让 Touka 多喜欢我一点再说。

lines.en: Or at least until she’s already decided to move in and it’s too late to pull out.
lines.zh: 或者至少等到她已经决定搬进去、来不及反悔为止。

lines.en: Hah. Pull out.
lines.zh: 哈。拔出来。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting18
: Um...Mother?
lines.zh: : 嗯……母亲？

lines.en: : Wait...Touka, are you actually interested in living somewhere like that?
lines.zh: : 等等……Touka，你是真的对住在那种地方感兴趣？

lines.en: : Well...the house you and Father bought me is truly lovely. Really, it is...
lines.zh: : 嗯……您和父亲给我买的房子真的很棒。真的，很棒……

lines.en: : But if I’m to really understand the lives and the minds of the laymen...perhaps it would be beneficial to throw myself directly into the fire?
lines.zh: : 但如果我要真正理解平民的生活与心智……也许直接把自己投进火里会更有益处？

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting19
: Touka...my little girl...you’re growing up so quickly...
lines.zh: : Touka……我的小女儿……你长大得好快……

lines.en: : Mother?! Why are you crying?!
lines.zh: : 母亲？！您为什么在哭？！

lines.en: : I’m just...so proud of you...
lines.zh: : 我只是……太为你骄傲了……

lines.en: : Stop that! You’re going to make me cry as well!
lines.zh: : 别这样！您会让我也哭出来的！

lines.en: : No crying in my office, please. Feel free to go out in the hall and come back once you’re done, though.
lines.zh: : 请不要在我的办公室里哭。不过你们可以先去走廊上哭完再回来。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting20
: Of course...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 当然……抱歉。

lines.en: : How...Or, rather...
lines.zh: : 怎么……或者说……

lines.en: : As my teacher, and please be honest with me...Do you think living in a place like that would be good for me?
lines.zh: : 作为我的老师，请诚实地回答我……您觉得住在那种地方对我有好处吗？

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t think it would be bad. But only you can really know what’s good for you.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我觉得不会有什么坏处。但只有你自己才能真正知道什么对你有好处。

lines.en: : I’m just some guy who gets to watch you fumble your way through life and extend a hand to help you up if it’s not too much of an inconvenience for me to do so.
lines.zh: : 我只是个看着你在人生中跌跌撞撞、然后在不怎么麻烦的情况下伸手拉你一把的家伙。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting21
: You’re extremely informal and cynical for a man in the educational field, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 作为一个教育界人士，您真是随便又愤世嫉俗，Sensei。

lines.en: : I truly do hope you know what you’re doing for all of our sakes and not just my own.
lines.zh: : 我真心希望您知道自己在做什么——为了我们所有人，而不只是为我。

lines.en: : Maybe I do. Maybe I don’t. There’s really only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 也许知道，也许不知道。真的只有一种办法能弄清楚。

lines.en: : If I were you, I’d probably jump at the chance to live in the dorms. And to do all sorts of other “commoner activities” as well.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，我大概会立刻抓住住进宿舍的机会。还会去做各种各样的“平民活动”。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting22
: Yes! Commoner activities!
lines.zh: : 对！平民活动！

lines.en: : Like...eating fast food! And shopping for discount shoes with the friends that I do not yet have!
lines.zh: : 比如……吃快餐！还有和我那些还没有的朋友一起去买打折鞋！

lines.en: : Sure. Those are definitely two things that exist.
lines.zh: : 当然。这两样东西确实存在。

lines.en: : Just...be careful not to eat too much of that fast food, dear. It can have horrible effects on your body over time.
lines.zh: : 只是……别吃太多那种快餐，亲爱的。时间久了，它会对你的身体产生可怕的影响。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m so excited!
lines.zh: : 哦，我好兴奋！

lines.en: : But, like I was saying before, there’s only one room left on the second floor. And you’ll be the only person living there until the final student transfers in.
lines.zh: : 不过，就像我刚才说的，二楼只剩一个房间了。而且在最后一名学生转进来之前，你会是唯一住在那儿的人。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting23
: That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : I’m rather used to being alone anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我也挺习惯一个人的。

lines.en: : So you agree to do exactly as this man says until you graduate from [high_school]?
lines.zh: : 那么，你同意在[high_school]毕业之前，完全按照这个男人说的去做？

lines.en: Thank you again to Tsubasa for wording that in a completely wholesome way that I will definitely not misinterpret and relive the next time my pants come off.
lines.zh: 再次感谢 Tsubasa 用如此纯良的方式措辞——我绝对不会曲解它，也绝对不会在下次脱裤子的时候回味它。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting24
: Fine. I agree.
lines.zh: : 好。我同意。

lines.en: : Though, let it be known that this is the very last chance.
lines.zh: : 不过，我要声明，这是最后一次机会。

lines.en: : And that the next moment I feel as if you are purposely teasing or ridiculing me, I’m having you fired.
lines.zh: : 而下一刻，只要我觉得你是在故意戏弄或嘲讽我，我就会让你被解雇。

lines.en: : Oh, well then just have me fired now because there is no way I’m not teasing you again in the future.
lines.zh: : 哦，那不如现在就让我被解雇吧，因为我以后绝对还会再戏弄你的。

lines.en: scene toukatsubasameeting25
: Again?! How dare you! And in a moment of great seriousness as well! Have you no shame?!
lines.zh: : 还会？！你竟敢！而且还是在这种极其严肃的时刻！你不知羞耻吗？！

lines.en: scene black
Touka spends the next several minutes yelling at me before her mother has to drag her out of the room for whatever rich person lesson she has today.
lines.zh: 接下来的几分钟里，Touka 一直冲我大吼大叫，直到她母亲不得不把她拖出房间，去上她今天要上的什么富人课程。

lines.en: Probably squash or something. That’s a rich person game, right?
lines.zh: 大概是壁球什么的。那是富人的运动，对吧？

lines.en: Either way, the Tsukiokas do not have me fired tonight as Touka ultimately apologizes for yet another one of her many overreactions over the brief course of time I’ve known her.
lines.zh: 无论如何，Tsukioka 家今晚没有让我被解雇——因为 Touka 最终还是为她在我认识她的这段短暂时间里又一次的过度反应道了歉。

lines.en: And while I can’t guarantee that her transition into the dorms will be easy, I can at least hope that it won’t be as rough as the one that brought her into the class...
lines.zh: 虽然我不能保证她搬进宿舍的过渡会很顺利，但我至少可以希望，它不会像把她带进这个班的那个过渡那么艰难……
